ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) data staging via 7-Zip followed by MEGAsync cloud exfiltration
ucs.description: Detects the characteristic INC Ransom pre-encryption exfiltration chain: bulk archiving with 7-Zip / WinRAR into a staging directory (C:\Temp, C:\ProgramData, C:\Users\Public, \Windows\Temp) followed within 30 minutes by MEGAsync.exe or MEGAcmd connections to mega.co.nz / mega.nz. INC Ransom (CrowdStrike: GOLD IONIC) has used this exact dual-extortion staging pattern across NHS Dumfries & Galloway, Xerox Business Solutions and Yamaha Motor Philippines intrusions.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstStage max(_time) as lastStage values(Processes.process) as ArchiveCmd values(Processes.user) as User values(Processes.dest) as Host from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*a *" OR Processes.process="*-p*" OR Processes.process="*.7z*" OR Processes.process="*.zip*" OR Processes.process="*.rar*") AND (Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\$Recycle.Bin\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| join type=inner dest user [
    | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstExfil max(_time) as lastExfil values(All_Traffic.dest) as ExfilDest values(All_Traffic.app) as ExfilProc from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.app IN ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","megacmdserver.exe") OR All_Traffic.dest IN ("mega.co.nz","mega.nz","*.userstorage.mega.co.nz","gfs*.userstorage.mega.co.nz")) AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" by All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.app
    | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
]
| eval StageToExfilSec = firstExfil - lastStage
| where StageToExfilSec >= 0 AND StageToExfilSec <= 1800
| table firstStage, lastStage, firstExfil, dest, user, process_name, ArchiveCmd, ExfilProc, ExfilDest, StageToExfilSec
| sort - firstExfil
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 1800;  // 30-min staging-to-exfil correlation per Huntress INC IR notes
let StagingPaths = dynamic(["\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Users\\Public\\","\\Windows\\Temp\\","\\$Recycle.Bin\\"]);
let Archives = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".7z",".zip",".rar")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (StagingPaths) or FolderPath has_any (StagingPaths)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project StageTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ArchiveTool = FileName, ArchiveCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Exfil = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","megacmdserver.exe")
         or RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ExfilProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ExfilCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
Archives
| join kind=inner Exfil on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend StageToExfilSec = datetime_diff('second', ExfilTime, StageTime)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime, StageToExfilSec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ArchiveTool, ArchiveCmd, ExfilProc, ExfilCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by ExfilTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 1800;
let StagingPaths = dynamic(["\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Users\\Public\\","\\Windows\\Temp\\"]);
let Archives = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\7z.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\7za.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith "\\7zG.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\WinRAR.exe"
         or NewProcessName endswith "\\Rar.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any (".7z",".zip",".rar")
    | where CommandLine has_any (StagingPaths)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project StageTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, User = SubjectUserName,
              ArchiveTool = NewProcessName, ArchiveCmd = CommandLine;
let Exfil = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DestinationHostName has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz")
         or RequestURL has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz")
         or DeviceCustomString1 has_any ("MEGAsync.exe","MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe")
    | project ExfilTime = TimeGenerated, Computer = SourceHostName,
              ExfilApp = coalesce(DeviceCustomString1, ApplicationProtocol),
              ExfilDest = coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL),
              DestinationIP, SourceUserName;
Archives
| join kind=inner Exfil on Computer
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend StageToExfilSec = datetime_diff('second', ExfilTime, StageTime)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime, StageToExfilSec, Computer, User,
          ArchiveTool, ArchiveCmd, ExfilApp, ExfilDest, DestinationIP
| order by ExfilTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\7z.exe OR *\\7za.exe OR *\\7zG.exe OR *\\7Z.EXE OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\WINRAR.EXE OR *\\Rar.exe OR *\\RAR.EXE) @CommandLine:(*.7z* OR *.zip* OR *.rar*) @CommandLine:(*\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\$Recycle.Bin\\*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@Image:(*\\MEGAsync.exe OR *\\MEGASYNC.EXE OR *\\MEGAcmd.exe OR *\\MEGACMD.EXE OR *\\MEGAclient.exe) OR @DestinationHostname:(*mega.nz OR *mega.co.nz OR *userstorage.mega.co.nz)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|7zG|WinRAR|Rar)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\.(7z|zip|rar)/i CommandLine=/\\(Temp|ProgramData|Users\\Public|Windows\\Temp|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\/i) OR (#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(^|\.)mega\.(nz|co\.nz)$|userstorage\.mega\.co\.nz$/i) OR (#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 ContextImageFileName=/\\(MEGAsync|MEGAcmd|MEGAclient|megacmdserver)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([event_simpleName, ImageFileName, ContextImageFileName, CommandLine, DomainName, RemoteAddressIP4], multival=true) | min(@timestamp, as=first) | max(@timestamp, as=last) })
| WindowSec := (last - first) / 1000
| WindowSec <= 1800
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom's playbook (documented by SentinelOne, Huntress, ReliaQuest, SOCRadar) consistently chains 7-Zip / WinRAR collection into common writable directories with MEGAsync as the exfil channel BEFORE deploying the encryptor. Generic 7-Zip detection is noisy and MEGA on its own is noisy, but the *temporal correlation* of the two on the same host within 30 minutes is INC-specific and rare in legi

ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom NTDS.dit theft via esentutl /vss + raw NTDS copy from shadow copy
ucs.description: Detects INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) domain-controller credential harvesting: invocation of esentutl.exe with /vss (or /y /d) to repair/copy ntds.dit out of a locked Volume Shadow Copy, or direct copy of \Windows\NTDS\ntds.dit from a VSS device path. INC operators have repeatedly used this living-off-the-land NTDS extraction method (per ReliaQuest and Huntress IR reports) instead of dropping Mimikatz/secretsdump, because the binary is signed by Microsoft and bypasses most AV.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen values(Processes.process) as Cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as Parent values(Processes.user) as User from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("esentutl.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","ntdsutil.exe")) AND ((Processes.process="*esentutl*" AND (Processes.process="*/vss*" OR Processes.process="* /y *" OR Processes.process="* /d *" OR Processes.process="*/m *") AND Processes.process="*ntds*") OR (Processes.process="*HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy*" AND Processes.process="*ntds.dit*") OR (Processes.process="*ntdsutil*" AND Processes.process="*ifm*" AND Processes.process="*create full*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT (user IN ("NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM") AND parent_process_name IN ("MsMpEng.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe"))
| sort - lastSeen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (FileName =~ "esentutl.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/vss", " /y ", " /d ", "/m ")
         and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds")
     or (ProcessCommandLine has "HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds.dit")
     or (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "ifm"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "create full")
     or (FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
         and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("esentutl","/vss","ntds"))
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandparentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          SHA256
| join kind=leftouter (DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, OSPlatform, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName)
  on DeviceName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\esentutl.exe"
         and CommandLine has_any ("/vss", " /y ", " /d ", "/m ")
         and CommandLine has "ntds")
     or (CommandLine has "HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy" and CommandLine has "ntds.dit")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
         and CommandLine has "ifm" and CommandLine has "create full")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe")
         and CommandLine has_all ("esentutl","/vss","ntds")
| where ParentProcessName !endswith "\\MsMpEng.exe"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith "\\TrustedInstaller.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom NTDS.dit Extraction via esentutl /vss
id: 7a3c1e3d-1b7a-4b9d-9c8b-incrnsm-ntds01
status: experimental
description: Detects esentutl.exe / ntdsutil.exe / shadow-copy access patterns used by INC Ransom (G1032 / GOLD IONIC) to dump NTDS.dit on domain controllers.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-05-23
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.t1006
  - attack.g1032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_esentutl:
    Image|endswith: '\esentutl.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/vss'
      - ' /y '
      - ' /d '
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ntds'
  selection_rawvss:
    CommandLine|contains: 'HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy'
    CommandLine|contains: 'ntds.dit'
  selection_ntdsutil:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
  filter_legit:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\MsMpEng.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
  condition: (selection_esentutl or selection_rawvss or selection_ntdsutil) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Authorized DR/backup tooling running scheduled ntds.dit integrity checks
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) ((@Image:(*\\esentutl.exe OR *\\ESENTUTL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*\/vss* OR *\ \/y\ * OR *\ \/d\ *) AND @CommandLine:*ntds*) OR (@CommandLine:*HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy* AND @CommandLine:*ntds.dit*) OR (@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*ifm* AND @CommandLine:*create\ full*)) -@ParentImage:(*\\MsMpEng.exe OR *\\TrustedInstaller.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\esentutl\.exe$/i AND regex("(/vss|\\s/y\\s|\\s/d\\s)", field=CommandLine) AND regex("ntds", field=CommandLine))
  OR (regex("HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy", field=CommandLine) AND regex("ntds\\.dit", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i AND regex("ifm", field=CommandLine) AND regex("create\\s+full", field=CommandLine))
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/^(MsMpEng|TrustedInstaller)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function={ collect([CommandLine], multival=true) | count() | min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen) | max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen) })
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) is consistently reported by ReliaQuest, Huntress and SOCRadar as relying on Microsoft-signed LOLBins for NTDS extraction rather than dropping Mimikatz or secretsdump.py — esentutl.exe /vss against ntds.dit and the raw shadow-copy device-path copy are their preferred fingerprint. Both patterns are nearly absent in benign administrative activity (legit AD backup tools use VSS
